building: Clayton W. Dement Fire Station (Purdue University Fire Department)

evidence: Purdue Archives identifies the Clayton W. Dement Fire Station (DMNT) as a three-bay brick fire station: https://collections.lib.purdue.edu/campus/buildings/53
Purdue Facilities Operations confirms PUFD is located at 1250 W Third Street: https://www.purdue.edu/operations/operations-maintenance/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2025/12/bd-manual.pdf
Official GIS FID 211 identifies DMNT at 1250 3rd Street. After localization, the model shell matches its 14 source vertices in local coordinates within 0.000058 m.
criteria.reason: The building identity is confirmed by primary sources; this is the Purdue Fire Department home station.

Marker rotation is zero and scale is unit. The marker links the exact intended relative library path.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
evidence: Official GIS lists two levels and an extrusion value of 15 without documenting the unit/meaning.
Model bounds remain 0–14.6 m. The roof-height split and raised apparatus hall are image-based estimates; no surveyed elevation source was found.
criteria.reason: Floor count and broad silhouette have support, but numeric heights are unverified and remain estimates.

evidence: Purdue archival record identifies brick construction and a three-bay station; current Street View shows two clear vehicle doors, a red canopy, personnel entry, brick office wing, and taller ribbed-metal hall.

Rendered preview and source panoramas were directly compared; façade materials/details are assigned and packaged in the asset. Source snapshots and URLs remain in audit/purdue_fire_department/evidence.json.
criteria.reason: Principal materials and massing are represented. The exact third-bay position/configuration is interpreted from the historic three-bay description because only two doors are clear in the current frontal panorama.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
evidence: Fresh Blender 5.2.3 open confirms 99 mesh objects, all 99 assigned materials, no external file images, expected scene/collection, and 100 total collection objects including AssetRoot.
Fresh master audit and independent master open both pass; no superseded massing collection is directly linked alongside the detail instance.
criteria.reason: Stable collection/path contract and self-contained materials are preserved after localization.

material_names: Dement | pale gray sectional bay doors

findings: The localized asset preserves the prior geometry and footprint fit; the world placement is recreated by the master marker.
Master marker uses the exact modular library path, correct XY, zero rotation, and unit scale; reconstructed world bounds agree with the manifest within tolerance.
Roof height is estimated; the current front view visibly supports two bay doors while the historic Purdue record calls the station three-bay. Exact third-bay configuration remains uncertain.
Interior layout is not modeled because available evidence does not support one.
